newsitem.title: EU: EP SUB MONETARY AFFAIRS COMMITTEE AGENDA - JAN 27-28.
newsitem.headline: EP SUB MONETARY AFFAIRS COMMITTEE AGENDA - JAN 27-28.

text.p: Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs and Industrial Policy [[ Monday 27 January 1997 ]] SUBCOMMITTEE ON MONETARY AFFAIRS ===] Monday 27 January 1997, 15.00 1. Adoption of draft agenda (PE220.815 ) 2. Approval of minutes of meetings of: - 13 November 1996 (PE220.812 ) - 16-17 December 1996 (PE220.811 ) 3. Chairman's announcements 4. Current monetary situation: Bulletin 1, January 1997 5. Meeting with Mr Giovanni RAVASIO, Director-General, DGII, European Commission on recent developments in monetary policy (from 15.00) - Exchange of views 6. Meeting with Mr Gert Jan HOGEWEG, Head of the Monetary, Economic and Statistics Department, European Monetary Institute, Frankfurt on the specification of the operational framework for the single monetary policy in Stage III (from 16.00) - Exchange of views 7. Effects of the EMU on fiscal policy (T03944) INI0348 INI0348 + ECON Fond R FOURCANS Andre. (PPE) (PE217.518/DT ) - Exchange of views 8. Convergence criteria, the third stage of EMU and the various social security systems (T04222) INI0514 INI0514 B4-0589/95 B4-0589/95 + ECON Fond R WILLOCKX Frederik A. (PE217.722/AM ) (PSE) - Exchange of views 9. New technologies and money - Rapporteur: John STEVENS - Exchange of views ===] Tuesday 28 January 1997, 09.00 10. Meeting with Sir Nigel WICKS, Chairman of the Monetary Committee, on progress towards Economic and Monetary Union (from 09.00) - Exchange of views 11. Meeting with Mr Henk BROUWER, Treasurer General, Ministry of Finance, The Hague, on progress of the information campaign in the Netherlands (from 10.45) - Exchange of views 12. Any other business 13. Date of next meeting (PE/IV/OJ/97-02/MONE ) - FIN - END OF DOCUMENT.
